tool_args.rationale: The equal-input row anchors the equilibrium coefficient, while multiple opposing/positive step contrasts at distinct horizons constrain gain and relaxation time. Fit the stated three-parameter normalized before/after law numerically; do not purchase an additional probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five varied rows including a zero-contrast row identify the equilibrium term and constrain contrast gain and relaxation time; no genuine identifiability ambiguity justifies the added cost.
The opposing-step signature and strong dependence on u_now-u_past distinguish perturbation contrast from a model using x_now alone.
It lacks the observed nonzero equal-step response, requiring an additional equilibrium contribution; the normalized before/after mechanism directly includes that term.
